tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dge kun rdzogs pa'i byang chub rab bsngo ba'i/ bsngo bshad rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'di na'o/ /

rab 'byams rgyal ba'i snying stobs brtson pa'i go /gcig char gyon pa'i rmad byung thugs rje yis/ /'gro rnams srid mtshor bying las 'dren mdzad pa/ /rnam 'dren shākya'i sras pos dge legs stsol/ /rab dkar dge tshogs gaṅgā'i 'gro ldan rgyun/ /ma lus kun mkhyen rgya mtsho chen po ru/ /bde blag nyid du 'jug pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ /bsngo smon rab yangs lam mchog 'di na mchis/ / 'di la yang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ /dang po rgyas pa ni/ dge 'dun pa rnams bsngo ba'i mthun 'gyur thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams grangs med cing mu mtha' dang bral ba na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ khyad par du'ang stong gsum mi mjed kyi zhing 'di'i dpal du gyur ba mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po/ rnam 'dren 'od dpag med/ rgyal ba sman gyi bla/ rgyal sras kun bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs la sogs pa rnams kyis/ 'dir nye bar 'khor ba'i dmigs yul 'di rnams kyi gtso byas mar gyur ba'i nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams can la gzigs shing dgongs su gsol/ mchog gsum dam pa de rnams kyi thugs rje dang*/ 'di ltar du bskrun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon byed du byas rang gzhan skye 'phags thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags shing*/ gzhi gsum dang 'brel ba'i rnam dkar gyi legs tshogs rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ skye rgu kun gyi rgud pa ma lus pa sel zhing*/ phan bde'i legs tshogs zad mi shes pa 'byung ba'i gnas dam pa/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang*/ bye brag tu'ang mnyam med btsong kha pa chen po gang des mdo sngags gnyis kyi sgo nas legs par bshad pa'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig

/zag bcas gyi phung po spangs nas zag med 'gyur ba rjo rje'i sku brnyes kyang*/ 'jig rten srid pa'i phun tshogs dang lus srog la rtag 'dzin gyis log par zhugs pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ mi rtag pa'i chos la bskul ba'i ched du gzugs sku'i dbyings su zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa/ rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa sbyi dang khyad par du'ang rnam 'dren zas gtsang gi sras po de nyid nas nye bar bzung*/ klu sgrub thogs med la sogs pa 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ dpal mar me mdzad ye shes yab sras dang*/ rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal yab sras rnams dang*/ paṇa chen ngag 'dun grub pa/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ bsod nams rgya mtsho/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgya mtshan/ mchog sprul blo bzang ye shes la sogs pa rgya bod kyi paṇa grub rim par byon pa rnams kyi thugs zag pa med pa'i dgongs pa khyad par can thams cad gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cigargyal ba'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa'i nyi ma/ rnam dpyod brtson pa'i shugs kyis bshad sgrub rta bdun gyi khri la legs par blangs nas gdul bya'i khams kun 'phrin las 'od gyis ches cher gsal ba mdzad pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa gang na su bzhugs pa spyi dang*/ khyad par du yang gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po sprul sku bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas dang*/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mtshan 'di dang 'di zhes bgyi pa la sogs pa bstan pa'i dpal du zhal bzhugs pa rnams kyi sku tshe mdzad pa 'phrin las la bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad 'phrin bzang po rnams mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cigadage 'dun gyi sde 'dis mtshon pa'i phyogs bcu'i zhing brjod kyis mi lang ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde rab 'byams rnams su bzhugs pa thams cad kyang*/

klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo/ spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo/ bya ba las kyi 'khor lo ste/ 'khor lo rim pa gsum la sogs pa legs tshogs kyi yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhig rgyas par gyur cig mchog gsum dam pa de rnams kyi thugs rje dang rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas bdag cag rnams la bsngo smon gyi re bltos 'cha' ba'i tshe 'das spyi dang*/ bye brag tshe las 'das pa ming 'di dang 'di zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa rnams kyi las ngan pa'i sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur cig tshe 'das de dag gi nye 'brel shul na mchis pa rnams kyis kyang*/ de rnams kyi ched du dmigs te dkon mchog mchod pa dang*/ dam chos bklag pa dang*/ /dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bsnyen bkur ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed cig bskrun pa thams cad kyang*/ tshe 'das rnams kyi rjes su 'brang zhing zhugs nas tshe 'das de dag thams cad mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad dang bral zhing*/ rang dang gzhan gyi 'byor ba bcu tshang ba'i mi'i lus rten rnam par dag pa rgyud ma nas brgyud mar thob nus pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig de ltar thob pa'i rten de la yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum la sogs pa'i sgo nas yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad thob pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig rtag tu sangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong zhing dam pa'i chos thos pa dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu la bkur sti rim gro tshul bzhin du bgyid nus pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig rang nyid gcig pu zhi ba'i bde ba la ma chags par sems can thams cad kyi ched du dmigs te byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas sbyin sogs phar phyir drug dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la sogs pa rgyal sras kyi spyod pa mtha' dag la rim gyis bslabs nas chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi skur myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur cig

de lta na'ang grangs med gsum du brtson pas lam bgrod pa'i ring la 'gro ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyis mnar bar ma bzod nas nye lam gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs/ rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i spyan sngar dbang bzhi rnam par dag pa thob cing*/ dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa mig gi 'bras bu ltar srung bar byed nus pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig de ltar bsrungs pa la brten nas smin byed bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ grol byed rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i lam rnams nyams su blangs te myur bar sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur cig gzhan yang dge ba 'di'i mthu la brten nas bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu gus pas mchod par byed pa'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag skya ser zhal bzhugs pa ji snyed ci mchis pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par sbyin pa'i bdag po ming 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba'i sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur ba'i nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags la sogs pa'i legs tshogs thams cad bsam pa bzhin du zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig de dag gis ji ltar yid la smon pa'i re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed pa la 'gal rkyen bar chad kyi mtshan ma skad cig tsam yang mi 'byung bar gyur cig 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa la mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po dang chos kyi rgyal bo btsong kha pa chen pos bka' bsgos gnyer du gtad pa'i srung ma'i dbang po mthu rtsal can spyi dang*/ khyad par myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po/ dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo la sogs pa chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang*/

tshangs dang dbang bo 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis kyang lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs te skad cig kyang g.yel ba med par grogs mdzad par gyur cig /'jig rten gyi khams rnams su yang char chu gnyen po dus su 'bebs shing lo phyugs rnams rtag tu legs par gyur cig mi nad phyu gnad dus kyi 'khrugs pa la sogs pa bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig sems can thams cad kyang bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod pa dang*/ bsam don rnams chos dang mthun par yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' la sogs pa dkar phyogs la dga' ba rnams kyi dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu nus pa stobs gzi brjid thams cad mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig nag phyogs pa rnams kyi rgyud kyi bsam pa ngan pa dang sbyor ba rtsub pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig mdor na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa dang*/ ji ltar smon pa'i gnas rnams kyang bde blag tu 'grub bar gyur cig rmad byung sras bcas sogs brjod do/ /cung mang bar dogs na tshig zur 'ga' zhig bsdus nas sam bzhag nas kyang chog go / ༈ gnyis pa 'bring po ni/ bsngo ba'i mthun 'gyur mdzad par zhu/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams brjod du med pa na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyis/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtso byas mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la dgongs su gsol/ mchog gsum dam pa de rnams kyi thugs rje dang rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ dge ba 'di nyid kyi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ 'gro ba kun gyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba ma lus pa 'byung zhing sdug bsngal gyi nad thams cad sel bar byed pa'i rtsi sman gyi ljon pa chen po/

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi lung rtogs kyi bstan pa spyi dang*/ khyad par du thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal yab sras kyis legs par bshad pa'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i snying po dri ma med pa 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par= /mi phyed pa'i rdo rje'i sku brnyes kyang*/ rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir du gzugs sku'i snang ba bsdus nas chos sku zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po mnyam med stobs bcu mnga' ba de nyid kyi thog mar mdzad/ 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis dpal mar me mdzad yab sras nas/ chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal yab sras rnams dang*/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba'i zhal snga nas dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas la sogs pa rnams kyi thugs zag med kyi dgongs pa khyad par can rnams gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par=/ da lta'ang bstan pa'i dpal du bzhugs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa spyi dang*/ khyad par du'ang sprul pa'i sku bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas la sogs pa bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa 'di dang 'di zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa thams cad kyi sku tshe mdzad pa 'phrin las la bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing rnam dkar gyi 'gro don bzang po rnams mi nyams shing gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par=/ gdan sa chen po ser 'bras dge gsum gtso byas phyogs bcu'i khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde rnams su dge 'dun pa rnams yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa la sogs pa chos spyod bcu'i sgrub ba bzang po rnams mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par=/ skyabs gnas dam pa de dag gi mthu rje dang bdag gzhan kun gyis bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas bdag sogs rnams la sngo ba'i re bltos 'cha' ba'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sngar/

sku gshegs pa spyi dang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag po tshe las 'das pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rnams kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa rnams byang zhing dag ste myur du mngon par rdzogs pas 'tshang rgya bar=/ tshe las 'das pa de dag gang du skyes sam skye 'gyur gyi rigs can zhig yin na'ang*/ rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po las grol te/ gzugs kyi phung po rnams par dag pa rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur myur du=/ tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa rgyal ba rin chen 'byung ldan gyi skur =/ 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi=/ 'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa rgyal ba don thams cad grub pa'i=/ rnam shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod ba'i=/ rigs thams cad kyi bdag po kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya =/ de ltar ma gyur ba'i tshe rabs thams cad du mi khom pa brgyad kyi gnas rnams su nam yang mi skye bar=/ rtag tu dal 'byor gyi rten sha stag thob cing mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun gyi rgyan dang mi 'bral bar =/ rtag tu'ang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rab tu 'byung zhing thos pa dang bsam pa dang bsgom pa rnam par dag pa bsgrub pa'i rten sha stag thob par=/ rten de rnams su'ang rang dang gzhan gyi don byed pa la mthun pa'i rkyen gzungs spobs mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs kyi yon tan khyad par can thob pa dag mi 'bral bar=/ gzhan yang dge 'dun gyi sde rnams mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag spyi dang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa'i skya ser thams cad kyi nad gnod pa rkyen phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar=/ tshe ring nad med 'byor ba la sogs pa'i mthun rkyen legs tshogs thams cad ji ltar bsam pa tsam gyis 'bad med lhun 'grub tu 'byung bar=/

de dag la chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen pos bka' bsgos gnyer du gtad pa'i srung ma'i dbang bo myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa la sogs pa chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis skad cig kyang g.yel ba med par grogs mdzad par=/ 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su lha klu rnams kyis char chu dus su 'bebs shing lo phyugs rnams rtag tu legs par=/ mi nad dang phyugs nad la sogs pa'i mi 'dod pa'i nyer 'tshe kun dang bkra mi shis pa dang mtshan pa ngan pa'i phyogs su gyur ba thams cad nye bar=/ yul phyogs 'di dang dgon gnas gtsug lag khang rnams srung zhing skyong bar byed pa'i gzhi bdag dkar phyogs la dga' ba rnams kyi mthu stobs nus pa thams cad mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par=/ nag phyogs pa rnams kyi bsam pa ngan pa dang sbyor ba log pa rnams nye bar zhi bar=/ mdor na bdag sogs rnams kyi mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa dang mos pa'i mthu las ji ltar smon pa'i don thams cad lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur cigasangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes ba'i byin rlabs dang*/ /zhes sogs brjod do/ /༈ gsum pa bsdus pa ni/ bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs gnang bar zhu/ phyogs bcu'i zhing grangs med pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis dmigs yul gyi thog drangs par gyur ba'i sems thams cad la dgongs su gsol/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos zhing dang bsam pa dang dngos po rnam par dag pa gsum gyis bskrun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon byed du byas pa'i rnam dkar gyi phung po rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang mnyam med btsong kha ba chen po'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'di nyid phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par=/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag gong ma chos kyi dbyings su zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' spyi dang*/

khyad par du'ang ston pa bla na med pa stobs bcu mnga' ba de nyid kyi thog mar mdzad/ 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub rim par byon pa rnams dang*/ dbang phyug brgyad ldan khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal yab sras la sogs pa gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir snga phyir rim par byon nas sku gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa rnams kyi thugs zag med kyi dgongs pa khyad par can yongs su rdzogs par=/ da lta'i dus su bstan pa'i dpal mgon du zhal bzhugs pa'i skyes bu dam pa spyi dang*/ gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po sbrul ba'i sku bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas la sogs pa rnams kyi sku tshe zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar du brtan cing*/ rnam dkar gyi 'phrin las rgya chen po phyogs bcur rgyas par=/ phyogs bcu'i 'dus pa'i sde rnams su dge 'dun rnams bslabs pa gsum gyi nyams len dang*/ sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel bar byed pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bya ba thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par=/ skyabs bzang po de rnams kyi mthu dang rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa la brten nas 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du song zhing tshe las 'das pa ji snyed yod pa dang*/ khyad par du tshe 'das ming 'di zhes bya ba la sogs pa rnams kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag nas myur du mngaun par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar=/ tshe las 'das pa de nyid kyis skye 'chi bar do gsum la de dag tu ngo shes nas rgyal ba'i sku gsum gyi skur myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar/ sangs ma rgyas pa'i skye ba thams cad du'ang ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i skye gnas dman pa rnams su dus skad cig tsam yang mi skye bar/ skye ba dang tshe rabs kun du'ang dal 'byor gyi rten rnam par dag pa thob cing rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas thos bsam sgoms pas mdo sngags kyi chos tshul kun la nyams len snying por byed nus pa'i skal ba dang ldan par =/

de ltar nyams su blangs pa la brten nas rgyal sras kyi sbyod pa mtha' dag la slob pa mthar phyin par byas te sems can thams cad kyi don du myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba gyur=/ gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag spyi dang*/ sbyin bdag 'di dang 'di zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa rnams kyi phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor la sogs pa'i legs tshogs thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhig rgyas par=/ sbyin pa'i bdag po de dag la chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis dus skad cig kyang g.yel ba med bar grogs mdzad par gyur=/ 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su'ang char chu dus su 'bab cing lo phyugs rnams rtag tu legs par=/ mi nad phyugs nad dus kyi 'khrugs pa la sogs pa mi 'dod pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad nye bar zhi bar=/ mdor na rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas shing rang dang gzhan gyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bsam don rnams chos dang mthun par yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /shākya'i dbang po 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /zhes sogs dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba dang zhes sogs brjod par bya'o/ /rnam kun mkhyen gzigs thub pa'i dbang po des/ /rnam mang dge ba'i cha shas cung zad kyang*/ /rnam grol rin chen 'byung gnas cher bsngos bas/ /rnam pa kun tu mdzad pa med ces gsungs/ /de phyir de ltar smon pa'i tshul 'di nyid/ /che bas che ba'i bka' yis bskul ba dang*/ /mkhas 'dod mkhas rlom bshad sgrub ming can gyis/ /don ldan don 'brel tshul du smras sam snyam/ /zhes pa 'di ni snga mo nas ko'u shrī yes kyis bskul ba ltar bris pa las phyis dka' ram gsar bu 'ga' zhig la phan srid snyam nas par du bsgrubs so/ /par gyi yi ge pa ni dga' bcu blo bzang dbang phyug go /par shing brkos mi dge 'dun tshe ring*/
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/dge kun rdzogs pa'i byang chub rab bsngo ba'i/ bsngo bshad rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhugs/ -PAGE 86--PAGE 85--PAGE 75-
